properties.name: buttons

properties.name: disableSensor

properties.name: disableInteraction

properties.name: isHorizontallyScrollable
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `isHorizontallyScrollable`（类型：`Signal<boolean>`），用于存储或配置是否为HorizontallyScrollable。

properties.name: thumbClass

exports.name: AsyncDetection
exports.summary:
Companion directive for `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` that watches the content for
DOM mutations (via `ContentObserver`) and re-triggers scrollbar layout updates.
exports.summaryZh:
用于 `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` 的配套指令，通过 `ContentObserver` 监听内容的
DOM 变化，并重新触发滚动条布局更新。

inputs.name: asyncDetection
inputs.description:
`'auto'` to keep watching for viewport/content-wrapper/spacer element changes indefinitely,
or `''` (default) to stop watching once found once.
inputs.descriptionZh: `'auto'` 表示持续监听视口/内容包裹层/占位符元素的变化，`''`（默认）表示找到一次后即停止监听。

exports.name: filterResizeEntries
exports.summary: Executes `filterResizeEntries` to handle filter resize entries.
exports.summaryZh: 执行 `filterResizeEntries`，用于过滤调整尺寸条目集合。

methods.name: filterResizeEntries
methods.description: Executes `filterResizeEntries` to handle filter resize entries.
methods.descriptionZh: 执行 `filterResizeEntries`，用于过滤调整尺寸条目集合。

exports.summaryZh: Angular 依赖注入令牌 `NG_SCROLLBAR_OPTIONS`，用于提供与注入Angular滚动条配置选项。

exports.summaryZh: Angular 依赖注入令牌 `NG_SCROLLBAR_POLYFILL`，用于提供与注入Angular滚动条POLYFILL。

exports.name: NgScrollbar
exports.summary:
Custom scrollbar component: wraps projected content in an internally-managed scrollable
viewport and renders custom scrollbar overlays over it.
exports.summaryZh: 自定义滚动条组件：将投影内容包裹在内部管理的可滚动视口中，并在其上渲染自定义滚动条覆层。

properties.name: contentWrapper
properties.descriptionZh: 内部内容包裹层元素的引用。

exports.name: NgScrollbarExt
exports.summary:
`ng-scrollbar` variant that renders custom scrollbar overlays on top of an *external*
viewport element (`[scrollViewport]`) that you control, instead of an internal one.
exports.summaryZh:
`ng-scrollbar` 的外部视口版本，在你自行提供的外部视口元素（`[scrollViewport]`）上方
渲染自定义滚动条覆层，而不是使用内部视口。

inputs.name: externalViewport
inputs.description: Selector used to query the viewport element.
inputs.descriptionZh: 属性 `externalViewport`（类型：`InputSignal<string>`），用于存储或配置外部视口（默认值：`input<string>()`）。

inputs.name: externalContentWrapper
inputs.description: Selector used to query the content wrapper element.
inputs.descriptionZh: 属性 `externalContentWrapper`（类型：`InputSignal<string>`），用于存储或配置外部内容包装器（默认值：`input<string>()`）。

inputs.name: externalSpacer
inputs.description:
Selector used to query the spacer element (virtual scroll integration).
In the case of integrating the scrollbar with a virtual scroll component,
a spacer element is typically created to match the real size of the content.
The scrollbar will use the size of this spacer element for calculations instead of the content wrapper size.
inputs.descriptionZh: 属性 `externalSpacer`（类型：`InputSignal<string>`），用于存储或配置外部Spacer（默认值：`input<string>()`）。

inputs.name: skipInit
inputs.description:
Skip initializing the viewport and the scrollbar
this is used when the component needs to wait for 3rd party library to render
inputs.descriptionZh: 输入属性 `skipInit`（类型：`boolean`），用于配置skip初始化。

properties.name: altViewport
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的视口元素覆盖值。

properties.name: altContentWrapper
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的内容包裹层元素覆盖值。

properties.name: altSpacer
properties.descriptionZh: 内部使用，由 {@link AsyncDetection} 等辅助指令写入的占位符元素覆盖值。

properties.name: viewportElement
properties.description:
The resolved external viewport element (from `[scrollViewport]`, `altViewport`, or the
`externalViewport` selector).
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部视口元素（来自 `[scrollViewport]`、`altViewport` 或 `externalViewport` 选择器）。

properties.name: viewportError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external viewport element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部视口元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: contentWrapperElement
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部内容包裹层元素。

properties.name: contentWrapperError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external content-wrapper element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部内容包裹层元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: spacerElement
properties.descriptionZh: 解析出的外部占位符元素。

properties.name: spacerError
properties.description: A diagnostic error message if the external spacer element couldn't be resolved, else `null`.
properties.descriptionZh: 若外部占位符元素解析失败则给出诊断错误信息，否则为 `null`。

properties.name: customViewport
properties.description: Reference to the external viewport directive if used
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `customViewport`（类型：`Signal<ScrollViewport>`），用于存储或配置自定义视口。

exports.name: NgScrollbarModule
exports.summary:
Convenience `NgModule` bundling {@link NgScrollbar}, {@link ScrollViewport},
{@link NgScrollbarExt}, `AsyncDetection` and `SyncSpacer` (all standalone) for NgModule-based apps.
exports.summaryZh:
便捷 `NgModule`，将 {@link NgScrollbar}、{@link ScrollViewport}、{@link NgScrollbarExt}、
`AsyncDetection`、`SyncSpacer`（均为 standalone）打包，供基于 NgModule 的应用使用。

exports.name: NgScrollbarOptions
exports.summary: Interface `NgScrollbarOptions` defining the contract and properties for ng scrollbar options.
exports.summaryZh: 接口 `NgScrollbarOptions`，定义Angular滚动条配置选项的数据结构契约与属性规范。

properties.name: orientation
properties.description:
Sets the scroll axis of the viewport.
- 'auto': Scrollbars are displayed for both vertical and horizontal scrolling.
- 'vertical': Scrollbars are displayed for vertical scrolling.
- 'horizontal': Scrollbars are displayed for horizontal scrolling.
Defaults to 'auto'.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `orientation`（类型：`ScrollbarOrientation`），用于存储或配置方向。

properties.name: visibility
properties.description:
Determines when to show the scrollbar.
- 'native': Scrollbar is visible when the viewport is scrollable, similar to native scrollbars.
- 'hover': Scrollbars are hidden by default and become visible on scrolling or hovering.
- 'visible': Scrollbars are always visible, even if the viewport is not scrollable.
Defaults to 'native'.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `visibility`（类型：`ScrollbarVisibility`），用于存储或配置visibility。

properties.name: appearance
properties.description:
Sets the appearance of the scrollbar.
- 'native': Scrollbar space is reserved within the viewport, similar to native scrollbars.
- 'compact': Scrollbars do not reserve any space and are placed over the viewport.
Defaults to 'native'.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `appearance`（类型：`ScrollbarAppearance`），用于存储或配置appearance。

properties.name: position
properties.description:
Sets the position of each scrollbar.
- 'native': Uses the default position as in native scrollbars.
- 'invertY': Inverts the vertical scrollbar position.
- 'invertX': Inverts the horizontal scrollbar position.
- 'invertAll': Inverts the positions of both vertical and horizontal scrollbars.
Defaults to 'native'.
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `position`（类型：`ScrollbarPosition`），用于存储或配置位置。

properties.name: trackClass
properties.description: A class forwarded to the scrollbar track element
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `trackClass`（类型：`string`），用于存储或配置track类名。

properties.name: thumbClass
properties.description: A class forwarded to the scrollbar thumb element
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `thumbClass`（类型：`string`），用于存储或配置thumb类名。

properties.name: buttonClass
properties.description: A class forwarded to the scrollbar button element
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `buttonClass`（类型：`string`），用于存储或配置按钮类名。

properties.name: trackScrollDuration
properties.description: Scrolling speed when clicking on scrollbar rail
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `trackScrollDuration`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置track滚动持续时间。

properties.name: disableInteraction
properties.description: A flag used to enable/disable the scrollbar pointer events
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `disableInteraction`（类型：`boolean`），用于存储或配置禁用Interaction。

properties.name: sensorThrottleTime
properties.description: Debounce interval for detecting changes via ResizeObserver
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `sensorThrottleTime`（类型：`number`），用于存储或配置sensor节流时间。

properties.name: disableSensor
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `disableSensor`（类型：`boolean`），用于存储或配置禁用Sensor。

properties.name: buttons
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `buttons`（类型：`boolean`），用于存储或配置按钮。

properties.name: hoverOffset
properties.description: A flag used to activate hover effect on the offset area around the scrollbar
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `hoverOffset`（类型：`boolean`），用于存储或配置hover偏移量。

exports.name: provideScrollbarOptions
exports.summary: Executes `provideScrollbarOptions` to handle provide scrollbar options.
exports.summaryZh: 执行 `provideScrollbarOptions`，用于提供滚动条配置选项。

methods.name: provideScrollbarOptions
methods.description: Executes `provideScrollbarOptions` to handle provide scrollbar options.
methods.descriptionZh: 执行 `provideScrollbarOptions`，用于提供滚动条配置选项。

exports.summary: Executes `provideScrollbarPolyfill` to handle provide scrollbar polyfill.

methods.name: provideScrollbarPolyfill
methods.description: Executes `provideScrollbarPolyfill` to handle provide scrollbar polyfill.

exports.name: ScrollbarOrientation
exports.summaryZh: 类型别名 `ScrollbarOrientation`，表示滚动条方向（`'auto' | 'vertical' | 'horizontal'`）。

exports.name: ScrollbarPosition
exports.summaryZh: 类型别名 `ScrollbarPosition`，表示滚动条位置（`'native' | 'invertY' | 'invertX' | 'invertAll'`）。

exports.name: ScrollbarUpdateReason
exports.summary: Enumeration `ScrollbarUpdateReason` defining supported scrollbar update reason constants.
exports.summaryZh: 枚举 `ScrollbarUpdateReason`，定义支持的滚动条更新Reason常量集合。

properties.name: AfterInit
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `ScrollbarUpdateReason.AfterInit` = 'AfterInit'，表示之后初始化。

properties.name: Resized
properties.descriptionZh: 枚举项 `ScrollbarUpdateReason.Resized` = 'ResizeObserver'，表示已调整尺寸。

exports.name: ScrollViewport
exports.summary:
Marks an element as the scrollable viewport that {@link NgScrollbarExt} should attach its
custom scrollbar overlay to.
exports.summaryZh: 将元素标记为 {@link NgScrollbarExt} 应附加自定义滚动条覆层的可滚动视口。

properties.name: nativeElement
properties.descriptionZh: 标记该指令所在的原生元素。

exports.name: SyncSpacer
exports.summary:
Companion directive for `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` that syncs a spacer element's
CSS custom properties (`--spacer-width`/`--spacer-height`) to the viewport's content size.
exports.summaryZh:
用于 `ng-scrollbar[externalViewport]` 的配套指令，将占位元素的 CSS 自定义属性
（`--spacer-width`/`--spacer-height`）与视口内容尺寸保持同步。

properties.name: spacerDimension
properties.description: A signal used to sync spacer dimension when content dimension changes
properties.descriptionZh: 属性 `spacerDimension`（类型：`WritableSignal<ElementDimension>`），用于存储或配置spacer维度（默认值：`signal({})`）。
